# maskera

> Swedish-first, client-side PII redaction for AI apps. maskera finds and masks Swedish personal data (names, personnummer, addresses, phone numbers, and more) before text reaches an LLM, a log, or analytics. Everything runs on-device (browser via WebGPU/WASM, or Node); your text is never sent anywhere. The packages contain no telemetry. The demo counts anonymous, cookieless page views, never your content. The default setup fetches the model weights and WASM runtime once as static assets (both can be self-hosted), never your content. Redactions are reversible via a restore map that stays with the caller.

Two layers, rules first:

- `@maskera/core` (npm): deterministic, checksum-validated detectors for structured Swedish PII: personnummer, samordningsnummer, organisationsnummer, phone, email, postnummer, bankgiro, plusgiro, IBAN, cards, IP, URL. Zero dependencies, synchronous. Custom patterns join via `regexDetector`.
- `maskera` (npm): everything in core plus `maskera-sv-ner`, my own Swedish NER model (KB-BERT fine-tuned, distilled to a 43 MB ONNX) that catches free-text names, places, organisations and street addresses, including all-lowercase chat text. On overlap, rules win. The hybrid also enables the low-risk free-text rule heuristics (street address, lägenhetsnummer) by default; `regnummer` is opt-in.

Quick start:

```ts
import { createNerRecognizer, redactWithNer } from "maskera"

const recognizer = createNerRecognizer()
const { text, restore } = await redactWithNer(
  "hej jag heter anna karlsson, personnummer 19900101-2385, och bor i uppsala",
  { recognizer },
)
// "hej jag heter [NAMN_1], personnummer [PERSONNUMMER_1], och bor i [PLATS_1]"
```

Benchmarks (exact-span F1, q4 quantized, measured 2026-07-19): 99.8% on the curated corpus (zero leaks), 94.7% on independent real text; leak rate 0.0% / 3.4%. Canonical table: https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md

Deployment boundary: the local/on-device claims above apply to this
open-source package and the maskera.dev browser demo. Maskera Cloud is a
separate managed service: content is processed in memory at an EU-owned
company in the EU with zero payload retention. Maskera Gateway is the private
deployment for a customer's own servers. Gateway is a signed OCI container
with the 43 MB model built in. It runs on CPU without a database, GPU or
separate model server, and masks routed AI traffic before the approved
upstream receives it.

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera#readme): install, API, architecture
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): the one canonical, dated, reproducible results table
- [Production notes](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/PRODUCTION.md): deployment and hardening guidance
- [Transparency](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera/blob/main/docs/TRANSPARENCY.md): privacy posture, what runs where

## Packages and model

- [maskera on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/maskera): rules + Swedish NER model, core re-exported
- [@maskera/core on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@maskera/core): rules only, zero dependencies
- [maskera-sv-ner on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/joelhagvall/maskera-sv-ner): the 43 MB Swedish NER ONNX model, training details

## Optional

- [Live demo](https://maskera.dev/): paste Swedish text, watch it get masked in the browser
- [For companies](https://maskera.dev/tjanster): compare open source, the managed Cloud API, and the private Gateway (Swedish)
- [Cloud and Gateway pricing](https://app.maskera.dev/pricing): the canonical commercial plans and prices
- [Private Gateway](https://app.maskera.dev/gateway): customer-hosted installation, security, and purchase flow
- [Source repository](https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera): monorepo with packages, training pipeline, and CI that re-grades the published model against a gold corpus
